note: Proposed by R-019 (stream D) for the maintainer. Not a protected file: evidence/protected/ is maintainer-only and nothing here edits it. The suite reads this file by default and reads a protected file instead when one is passed with --tolerances. An element passes when |got - ref| <= atol_rel * scale + rtol * |ref|, with ref from CpuOps (double, rounded once to the element type), or from an upstream golden, and scale the RMS of ref (or the largest |V| of the pool for attention). Exact classes compare bytes. The values are the ones R-017 proposed (kernels/README.md) and measured against SM 86; the largest utilisation each class reached in R-019's own runs is in the results files, not here.
